The structure of Mg3Co6Cu3S16 crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Co and Cu each adopt tetrahedral environments with four S neighbors, while Mg is surrounded by eight S neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites. Polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Co and Cu tetrahedra and between Co tetrahedra and Mg 8-vertex coordination polyhedra, though these selected patterns do not assert an exclusive sharing type.
